change: Count each robot inside-to-fully-outside transition independently, including overlapping exits and re-exits.
negative_control: The new native overlapping-exit regression fails on the old updater when YELLOW exits while RED remains outside: 1 instead of 2.

equivalence.scope: Valid initialized runs with the same recorded native states.
equivalence.zero_exit_predicate: Old count is zero if and only if the corrected count is zero. Both stay positive after the first observed exit.
equivalence.qualification: Official success requires zero penalties, so success and early-declaration predicates are unchanged.
equivalence.physics: Motion reads neither counter nor event log. Both implementations call mj_forward once; added bounds calculations do not mutate physics.
equivalence.changed_metrics: Failed-run penalty totals, objective returns and mean score may decrease.

reproducibility: Benchmark reports keep their original e2be32d commit and hashes. Historical event states should be resumed under their recorded source.

frozen_test_score_audit.interpretation: All frozen episodes retain zero exit penalties; the subsequent exit-counter correction does not change the reported scores in this particular test.
